home.title: FinalCheat · VitaCheat Overlay
home.description: VitaCheat Overlay, a full-screen PS Vita cheat-list interface, original PSVITACHEAT Z06 downloads, and the complete code-format reference.
home.intro:
Open a full-screen list in your game, select a cheat, and press Square.
Your familiar `.psv` codes, with an interface that is easier to use.
home.screenAltEn: VitaCheat Overlay English interface in Virtua Tennis 4, showing selected entries and capsule switches
home.screenAltZh: VitaCheat Overlay Simplified Chinese interface in Virtua Tennis 4, showing selected entries and capsule switches
features: Share `vitacheat/db`, with UTF-8 and GBK support.
English, Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, or follow the system.
Square toggles, L/R pages. Configure opacity and the opening shortcut.
home.referenceIntro:
The original PDF's formats, fields, and examples, organized for the web.
From direct writes and pointers to modules, buttons, and conditions.
home.legacyIntro: The original tool and its documentation remain available. Use the original download links for the complete files and user manuals.
home.driveCaption: Plugin files, examples, and user manuals
